name: Torch
summary: Burns 1 hour: Bright Light 20 ft, Dim Light 20 ft beyond; can hit for 1 Fire damage.
text: Once lit, a Torch burns for 1 hour, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for another 20 feet beyond that. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch as a Simple Melee weapon; on a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.
